CritiqueIssue.description:
One defect, written so a refactorer can fix it without re-reviewing: which rule, where, what was seen, why it
matters, and the smallest fix.

target.description: the whole script, or the scene or clip it is about
target.title: Target

criterion.description: the rubric line it breaks: S script · P plan · V video critic; B basic need · G good to have · X great if followed; then its number (P-B3)
criterion.title: Criterion

tier.description: basic: must always hold (blocks a pass) · good: expected quality · great: polish
tier.title: Tier

aspect.description: script: outline-fit · clarity · flow · pacing · speakability · tone; plan: clarity · sync · constructability · design; video: plan-match · sync · render · design
aspect.title: Aspect

evidence.description: what was seen and where: a quote, a beat, a frame time, a sync offset
evidence.title: Evidence

problem.description: what is wrong, in one or two sentences
problem.title: Problem

impact.description: what it does to the viewer, the build or the sync
impact.title: Impact

fix.description: the smallest change that solves it
fix.title: Fix

CritiqueIssue.title: CritiqueIssue

reviewed.description: `text-2-shorts hash <run> script` or `… sNN plan|video`: the version reviewed
reviewed.title: Reviewed

score.description: 100 − 25 per basic − 10 per good − 3 per great issue (floor 0); pass = no basic issue and score ≥ quality_threshold
score.title: Score

summary.description: 2–4 sentences: the verdict and why, the biggest risk, what already works
summary.title: Summary

strengths.description: what works and must survive the refactor
strengths.title: Strengths
